subject: BridgeOps tracer adapter pilot — tracing + prompt metadata
messages:
From: Patrick O'Neill <patrick@bridgeops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@promptlab.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: BridgeOps tracer adapter for Redwood — pilot ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick conversation at the AI infra meetup last week — enjoyed the demo of Redwood Dedicated. As discussed, BridgeOps has a lightweight tracing library (BridgeTracer) that captures model-level spans, prompt tokens, and downstream tool calls. Our customers are asking for a first-class integration with inference platforms so tracing and prompt metadata are consistent end-to-end across apps.

We put together a short integration proposal (attached) that outlines:
- an adapter to ingest BridgeTracer spans into Redwood's tracing pipeline,
- a minimal mapping of BridgeTracer fields to Redwood's prompt/trace schema, and
- a 4-week pilot plan (POC + smoke tests + success criteria).

High-level asks from our side:
1) A small pilot instance on Redwood Dedicated or a private sandbox where we can validate KV cache/latency effects.
2) A joint SDK/workshop so your SDK and our tracer can emit consistent prompt ids and call metadata.
3) Agreement on observability signals (trace id linking, token counts, failure tagging).

Would you be open to a short scoping call this week? If helpful I can loop in one of our engineers (Sarah) who did the adapter work for a different vendor.

Attachments: bridgeops-integration-proposal.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Patrick O'Neill
Head of Partnerships, BridgeOps
patrick@bridgeops.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Patrick O'Neill <patrick@bridgeops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: BridgeOps tracer adapter for Redwood — pilot ask

Patrick —

Appreciate the outline and the proposal. This aligns well with the Optimize and Console roadmaps (observability + prompt-level accounting). Happy to scope a pilot.

Proposed next steps:
- Quick 30-min scoping call on Wed 03/24 10:00am PT to agree success criteria and the sandbox environment (I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm).
- You'll share the BridgeTracer field map ahead of the call (Sarah copied if that's easiest).
- We'll share our internal tracing spec (attached) and a minimal test harness that emits a few synthetic traces for validation.

I've looped in Karthik and Priyom who'll own the runtime/SDK work and the observability contract. If you want Lauren from partner ops on the kickoff we can add her to the invite.

Attachment: redwood-tracing-spec.md

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Ecosystem Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: BridgeOps tracer adapter for Redwood — pilot ask

Folks — forwarding a short ask from BridgeOps (attached). TL;DR: they want a tracer adapter that maps BridgeTracer spans & prompt metadata into our tracing pipeline. They see this as a partner-led integration that could become a productized connector in the ecosystem marketplace.

Initial thoughts / questions for us before the scoping call:
- SDK surface: do we expose a thin shim in the JS/Python SDK or implement a server-side ingestion adapter? Karthik, which is lower risk for Dedicated/private deployments?
- Data model: Priyom, quick sanity check on the mapping in the attached spec. Any fields that look problematic for compliance (PII, token content)?
- Metrics & SLOs: Lauren, should we treat this as an observability feature (no SLA change) or a feature for Dedicated with an optional premium support tier?

Proposed owners: Karthik (tech lead), Priyom (data model/review), Lauren (commercial + partner ops). I can own partner coordination and the pilot MOU.

Action: please review the attached and post thoughts on the PR link below by EOD tomorrow so we have prep notes for Wed.

PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tracing-adapters/pull/78

— Marissa
From: Patrick O'Neill <patrick@bridgeops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@promptlab.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: BridgeOps tracer adapter for Redwood — pilot ask

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping folks in. A few clarifications ahead of the call:
- BridgeTracer does not send raw prompt text by default; we include token counts and a hashed prompt fingerprint. We can toggle richer payloads for private environments if customers opt in.
- The adapter we're proposing is intentionally small: it translates three core span types (request, model_call, tool_call) and adds a prompt_id that your SDK can surface.
- We're happy to provide a small test harness and a k8s manifest for a non-prod sandbox that mirrors a Dedicated node.

Sarah (cc) will join the call and can demo the adapter in our staging environment (10–15 minutes).

Looking forward to Wed — please send the invite and call link.

Best,
Patrick
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: BridgeOps tracer adapter for Redwood — pilot ask

Quick summary + action items from internal review:

Summary: BridgeOps adapter looks feasible as a server-side ingestion shim for Dedicated/private deployments (lower blast radius). Token fingerprinting is acceptable; no raw prompt content unless explicitly toggled by customer and captured under opt-in.

Action items:
- Karthik: prototype adapter (server-side) and open a draft PR for review — ETA 2 weeks (PR branch: brg/adapter-pilot).
- Priyom: data-model review and compliance sign-off for optional richer payloads — ETA 5 business days.
- Lauren: draft pilot MOU (duration, success criteria, support level) and pricing for a 6-week pilot — ETA 3 business days.
- Marissa: schedule scoping call (you already offered) and own partner comms / pilot MOU.

I'll start a design doc and push the prototype skeleton to the repo (link in the PR) tomorrow. If anyone sees blocking concerns please shout out.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
